from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485207/attempts/aebe2cf00e3243528294ba8447492ab6/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''def transform(grid):\n    divider = next(i for i, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == 5)\n    left = [row[:divider] for row in grid]\n    right = [row[divider + 1:] for row in grid]\n    if any(a != 0 and b != 0 for row_a, row_b in zip(left, right) for a, b in zip(row_a, row_b)):\n        return left\n    return [[a if a != 0 else b for a, b in zip(row_a, row_b)] for row_a, row_b in zip(left, right)]\n'''
path=program_dir/'task-3a5e8f4c.py'
